# AnySlide

AnySlide is an open-source AI slide, knowledge-card, and image generation app.

Public project resources:

- Repository: https://github.com/xspring1982/AnySlide
- License: AGPL-3.0-only
- Self-hosting: see SELF_HOSTING.md in the repository

Self-hosted deployments should publish their own canonical URLs and support
contacts. This file intentionally does not reference private hosted-service
domains or provider accounts.
